title: About the Shadowing Theorem for piecewise smooth vector fields with sliding motion
summary: Since every modeling process in real-world situations is subject to errors, the study of the so-called shadowing property becomes highly relevant. This property allows for the identification of true orbits that closely follow a chain of trajectories in which some degree of approximation is introduced at each step. The objective of this paper is to establish a version of the Shadowing Theorem for vector fields governed by ordinary differential equations in the piecewise-smooth setting, where the dynamics alternate between distinct regimes, or on-off stages.
